intent: Refresh the live First Stage Bill inventory, verify it against current official Oireachtas state, propose the stage-specific grouping and one-slide information hierarchy, then build one representative First Stage Bill slide through the existing Bill Tracker factory for hosted human review. Do not publish or schedule.

data_sources.source: Houses of the Oireachtas legislation API and official Bill/debate documents

references_consulted: Irish Politics Data Model public documentation

decisions.question: Which architecture should the prototype use?
decisions.choice: Extend bill_tracker_factory_v1 on the session branch; no parallel permanent renderer.
decisions.rationale: Current main marks bill_tracker_series as merged and the handoff explicitly requires extending the existing factory.

decisions.question: How should the live six-Bill inventory be grouped?
decisions.choice: Use 3 Bills in Post 1 and 3 Bills in Post 2, producing six slides per post: cover + three Bill slides + process glossary + First Stage explainer.
decisions.rationale: The live official inventory contains six current First Stage Bills, not seven, so retaining a 3/4 split would knowingly preserve stale inventory assumptions.

decisions.question: Which Bill should anchor the prototype?
decisions.rationale: Layout/data complexity only: long title, three named sponsors, substantive initiated text and explanatory memorandum, and enough legal-effect detail to stress-test a single-slide hierarchy without requiring a vote slide.

hierarchy: WHERE IT IS NOW / WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

bills: Energy Poverty Reduction (Use of Surplus Renewable Energy) Bill 2025

visual_decisions.family: canonical Bill Tracker Enacted visual grammar
visual_decisions.first_stage_bill_slide: one substantive slide per Bill by default
visual_decisions.comparable_box_typography: shared-fit sizing based on the most constrained comparable component
